description: Get the receipt of a mined Arbitrum One transaction: success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in ETH, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use arb_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xf03682db039f7b1b72ddf4d17572738f142cf63ecb36c90afa570430ea9774c4. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: arb_receipt
title: Arbitrum One transaction receipt
